model.shadow.review.challenge-transition: A caller-held self-digested checkpoint cannot authenticate origin or authority.
Portable checkpoint data is not proof that an independent party retained it.
Neither caller checkpoint data nor caller-owned files are a protected monotonic substrate.
Relative rollback detection does not prevent deletion rollback or joint replacement.

state.local.file-fsync.directory-hardwar: The read-only adapter adds no directory-entry or hardware durability evidence.

model.shadow.review.challenge-transition: No authenticated key or policy rotation authority exists.
Presented artifacts do not prove separate controllers.
A portable comparison cannot exclude collusion or withheld roots.
A library audit does not prove human review.
An explicit library call does not authenticate the host or caller.
Checkpoint and audit times are caller supplied.
Independent roots and withheld histories remain possible.
Equal bracketing reads cannot exclude intermediate changes that revert.
